title: Antarctic Monthly Near-Surface Air Temperature Anomaly Reconstruction
summary: Use raw monthly anchor-station temperature releases and ERA5 spatial relationships to reconstruct 1958-2022 monthly Antarctic 2 m air-temperature anomalies on a 114 x 114 grid.
evaluation: Evaluation checks deliverable completeness, schema and coverage, physical and reference-period consistency, agreement of the submitted target with a private expert field and held-out station observations, reproducibility, and compliance of the representative figure with its deterministic plot contract.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
